The loot economy is framed as risk/reward: dangerous zones yield better gear; safe zones yield scraps. The design-layer framing over M8-EXT-01 + M12-EXT-38.

Per-faction {fame, infamy} dual-axis vectors (FNV model). No global alignment meter. Fame = helped faction; Infamy = harmed faction. Both axes tracked independently. Net standing = fame − infamy gates vendor prices, quest access, patrol behavior, and faction-specific mechanical unlocks. Both high-fame and high-infamy paths reach all mechanical endpoints (different flavor). 5 built-in factions + 1 player-founded dynamic faction.

The 5th built-in faction: pre-war continuity government. Doctrine "Order through strength" — centralized command, heavy armor, air assets, NBC gear, working comms, drone recon, artillery strikes, pre-war logistics. High-tech/low-numbers; slow replenishment; ideological foil to Raiders (chaos) and Military (loyalist order). Visual: digital woodland → urban camo transition; vehicle convoys; fortified FOBs.
